note: Rendered from the sealed S and X records. No question, gold call, or stored response.

function.name: country_info_largest_city
function.description: Fetch the largest city of a specified country. Unlike country_info_capital, which fetches the capital city, this fetches the largest city.

function.name: country_info_capital
function.description: Fetch the capital city of a specified country. Unlike country_info_largest_city, which fetches the largest city, this fetches the capital city.

function.name: country_info_population
function.description: Fetch the current population of a specified country. Unlike country_info_largest_city, which fetches the largest city, this fetches the current population.
